scope_label: Bulgarian historical and current award systems

sources.coverage_result: 2/2 overview pages and images processed; both were portraits and excluded.

sources.source_name: World Medals Index - Principality/Kingdom, People's Republic, and Republic of Bulgaria
sources.coverage_result: All three masterlists were opened: 30 Principality/Kingdom entries, 81 People's Republic entries, and 8 Republic entries (119 linked candidates). 36 object pages were opened (28 Principality/Kingdom and 8 Republic); 14 pages exposed candidate object views. Twenty front variants and 17 matching reverse views were downloaded and decoded. No People's Republic object page was opened. 83 listed object pages remain unreviewed, so directory coverage is partial.
sources.image_quality: All selected source images have a 250px long edge; complete visible objects are retained and marked low-resolution reference.
sources.rights_status: The individual article pages do not state photographer or redistribution terms; preserve attribution and treat redistribution rights as unverified.

sources.source_name: Bulgarian Presidency, official awards and legislation
sources.coverage_result: The official Presidency overview was opened and used to identify current Republic award sections and stated degree/category distinctions. It has not yet been exhaustively transcribed into raw candidates or used for image downloads.

next_action: Process the People's Republic object pages and image candidates from the 81-entry WMI list, then cross-check current Republic grades against official Presidency material.
